description:
We're looking for a strategic, creative, and results-driven Manager Integrated Campaigns & Verticals to lead how we bring our go-to-market strategy to life across channels, audiences, and industries.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution. You'll translate company priorities, product launches, and customer insights into compelling, integrated marketing campaigns that build awareness, create demand, and drive pipeline.

You'll also own our vertical marketing strategy, identifying high-potential industries, developing differentiated messaging and use cases, and building repeatable programs that help us win in priority segments.

The ideal candidate is equal parts strategist, storyteller, and operator. You know how to turn a strong market insight into a campaign that resonates, orchestrate cross-functional teams, and measure what matters. You're comfortable building the strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute.

What You'll Do

Integrated Campaign Strategy & Execution for MM and Enterprise

  • Own the integrated campaign strategy and calendar, aligning marketing investments with company priorities, growth objectives, and revenue targets.

  • Develop and execute full-funnel campaigns across paid media, email, lifecycle, content, webinars, events, social, and sales activation.

  • Build compelling campaign narratives, creative briefs, audience strategies, and activation plans that create a consistent experience across channels.

  • Partner with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Content, Brand, Field Marketing, and Sales to orchestrate campaigns from concept through execution.

  • Establish a scalable campaign operating model, including planning, launch processes, performance reporting, and continuous optimization.

  • Drive campaign performance against clear business outcomes, including pipeline creation, pipeline influence, conversion, and revenue.

Vertical Marketing & Industry GTM

  • Define and own the vertical marketing strategy, prioritizing industries based on market opportunity, customer fit, competitive dynamics, and growth potential.

  • Develop differentiated industry narratives, messaging, value propositions, and use cases in partnership with Product Marketing.

  • Build vertical-specific campaigns and programs that resonate with industry buyers and buying committees.

  • Create repeatable industry GTM playbooks, including customer stories, sales enablement, targeted content, and demand generation programs.

  • Partner closely with Sales leadership to identify vertical opportunities, accelerate penetration, and improve win rates in strategic segments.

  • Test new verticals, validate market opportunities, and scale successful programs.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Performance

  • Serve as the connective tissue across GTM functions, ensuring campaigns are coordinated, cohesive, and aligned to business priorities.

  • Partner with Marketing Operations and Analytics to define campaign measurement, attribution, reporting, and performance insights.

  • Use customer insights, intent signals, funnel data, and experimentation to continuously improve campaign effectiveness.

  • Leverage AI and automation to accelerate campaign development, personalization, content production, and optimization.

  • Communicate campaign priorities, results, and learnings to marketing and executive leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, including significant ownership of integrated campaigns, demand generation, segment marketing, or industry GTM.

  • Proven experience building and scaling integrated campaigns that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

  • Experience developing vertical or industry-specific marketing strategies, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Strong understanding of full-funnel marketing, buyer journeys, audience segmentation, and multichannel orchestration.

  • Exceptional storytelling and messaging instincts, with the ability to translate complex products into compelling customer-facing narratives.

  • Strong analytical orientation and ability to connect campaign performance to business outcomes.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

  • Experience partnering closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, and Revenue Operations.

  • A builder mentality: comfortable creating structure, moving quickly, experimenting, and operating in an evolving environment.

  • Curiosity and hands-on experience using AI to improve marketing creativity, efficiency, and performance.
